purpose: Actual Unreal terrain albedo assets, not concept screenshots

prompts.T_VoxelMeadow: Create a production game texture: one square seamless tileable albedo texture of dense short mossy meadow grass for a richly detailed voxel / pixel fantasy village. Entire image is a flat orthographic top-down material sample, edge to edge, without border, no landscape, no perspective, no buildings, no props, no labels. Fine angular square-ish grass clusters and tiny clipped leaves with crisply stepped pixel-like edges. Olive, ochre-green and muted warm moss tones, overall average sRGB approximately #7b873d, small darker earthen specks. Physical sample covers about 2 meters. Dense but restrained natural irregular variation, very small pale straw blades and tiny soil gaps, equal lighting everywhere, no baked directional shadow or highlights, no large isolated motif, seamless left-right and top-bottom. Stylized hand-authored voxel-world surface detail, NOT photorealistic grass, NOT blurry painterly gradients, NOT giant checkerboard squares. 1024 by 1024 square texture.
prompts.T_MossLimestone: Create one square seamless tileable game albedo material texture, edge-to-edge weathered mossy limestone cliff face for detailed voxel / pixel fantasy terrain. Flat orthographic material sample only, no scene, perspective, framing, props, text or labels. Small irregular angular grey-brown olive stone blocks interlock naturally as fractured rock strata, broken squared corners and fine stepped pixel details; thin recessed fissures, scattered muted dark green moss within cracks about 15 percent of area. Average sRGB color warm #77735b, stone ranges subdued taupe #918970 to deep warm grey #555547. Physical sample represents two meters of rock. Natural geological bedrock, NOT manufactured regular brick wall. Even diffuse lighting, restrained relief cues, no directional lighting, no vignette, no huge black cracks, no white highlights. Exact seamlessly continuous left/right and top/bottom edges. Rich finely textured voxel RPG terrain style matching mossy golden green grass and terracotta village houses. 1024 by 1024 square.
prompts.T_OchreGravel: Create one square seamless tileable albedo texture for a detailed voxel pixel fantasy game's warm ochre gravel footpath. Flat orthographic top-down material sample filling entire image, no scene no perspective no text no borders. Fine tightly packed angular chipped limestone gravel, tiny square-ish cream buff and muted gold stones in dusty ochre earth, crisp pixel-like edges. Restrained small-scale grain, no large cobbles, no smooth gradients, no grass. Overall medium warm golden beige average #b59b5f, with tiny darker sand crevices and pale straw-colored mineral flakes. Physical tile covers 2 meters. Even ambient lighting, no directional shadows or glossy highlights. Seamless both axes, no focal motif. Should harmonize with olive mossy meadow and warm limestone cliffs in a terracotta-roof voxel village. 1024 by 1024 square.
